description: This file defines a JobStore class responsible for managing job lifecycle, persistence, and file operations within a filesystem-backed job processing system. It includes methods for creating jobs, updating their status, saving uploads, and cleaning up job directories. It also uses data classes and external schemas for job metadata and detection summaries.

classes.name: JobPaths
classes.description: Container of filesystem paths associated with a specific job, including root, metadata, upload, work, and result directories.

methods.name: JobCreated create_job(self, initial_status: JobState = JobState.PENDING, message: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new job directory structure, initializes meta.json with initial state, and returns a JobCreated object.

methods.name: dict _read_meta(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Reads and returns the metadata JSON for a specific job.

methods.name: None _write_meta(self, job_id: str, meta: dict)
methods.description: Writes the provided metadata dictionary to the job's meta.json file.

methods.name: JobStatus update_status( self, job_id: str, *, status: Optional[JobState] = None, progress: Optional[int] = None, message: Optional[str] = None, result_url: Optional[str] = None, detections: Optional[List[PerFileDetectionSummary]] = None, )
methods.description: Updates job status, progress, message, result URL, or detection summaries, then saves changes.

methods.name: JobStatus save_error(self, job_id: str, error_message: str)
methods.description: Sets the job status to ERROR and records an error message.

methods.name: JobStatus get_status(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the current job status and associated metadata.

methods.name: None save_uploads(self, job_id: str, drawings_zip_path: Path, logo_image_path: Path)
methods.description: Legacy method to save ZIP and logo images into job uploads directory.

methods.name: None save_uploads_flexible( self, job_id: str, logo_image_path: Path, drawings_zip_path: Optional[Path] = None, individual_files_dir: Optional[Path] = None, )
methods.description: Supports saving uploads including logo, optional zip containing drawings, and individual files into the job's uploads directory.

methods.name: Path get_uploads_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the uploads directory for a specific job.

methods.name: Path get_work_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the work directory for a specific job.

methods.name: Path get_result_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the result directory for a specific job.

methods.name: JobStatus set_result_url(self, job_id: str, result_url: str)
methods.description: Updates the job metadata with a result URL.

methods.name: None cleanup(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Removes the entire job directory and its contents from filesystem.
